body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, the target is Distracted until the start of your next turn; you suffer -1 Fortitude against it for that duration, but gain +1 to your next Cunning Success Die against it.

surges.html: On a hit, the target is also Exposed until the start of your next turn.
You may end your own Fortitude penalty immediately after your next Cunning hit against it.

rider.title: Contingency - Gambit
rider.html: When the target declares an attack against you before your next turn, you may move 2 units without triggering its movement Reactions; recheck range afterward.
